title: warm-rule-cache
summary: Fills the lint rule cache for a project index; index runs warm it, or start it in the background (--rule-cache-warm)
intro: Computes the whole-project lint rules (circular-uses, enum-helper-separate-units, duplicate-global-decl) for a project index and stores them, so the next lint of any unit is a cache hit. Every project index run warms it; --rule-cache-warm background detaches it (the run returns at once), off skips it, DRAGLINT_RULE_CACHE_WARM sets the default. It writes only if no index changed meanwhile. A warm stops at once on drag-lint shutdown (exit 4), and an index of the same database stops a stale warm. Contributed by Jonathas Paiva (PR #1).
